from mavsdk.mission import MissionPlan
# East zone, center E130 N0, box east 100..160, north -30..30, alt 20
wps = [(100,-25),(160,-25),(160,0),(100,0),(100,25),(160,25)]
items = []
for e,n in wps:
    g = await world_to_geo(e,n,20)
    items.append(mission_item(latitude_deg=g.latitude_deg, longitude_deg=g.longitude_deg, relative_altitude_m=20, speed_m_s=6))
await drone.mission.upload_mission(MissionPlan(items))
await arm_and_start()
async for p in drone.mission.mission_progress():
    log(f"{p.current}/{p.total}")
    if p.total>0 and p.current==p.total:
        break
log("east zone survey done")

**PLAN — one drone per zone:**
- **d0 → Zone A** (E130 N0): box E100–160, N−30–30, altitude 20 m
- **d1 → Zone B** (E0 N130): box E−30–30, N100–160, altitude 20 m
- **d2 → Zone C** (E−130 N0): box E−160–−100, N−30–30, altitude 20 m
- **d3 → Zone D** (E0 N−130): box E−30–30, N−160–−100, altitude 20 m

Zones are ~260 m apart center-to-center → separation minimum (6 m) easily satisfied once deployed. Each zone gets a 3-pass lawnmower spaced 25 m (passes at −25/0/+25 offset → covers the full 60 m width, well over 60%).

Zones lie in four different compass directions so transit paths diverge (no separation conflict).

args.code:
from mavsdk.mission import MissionItem, MissionPlan
# Zone A center E130 N0 -> boustrophedon, passes at N=-25,0,25 sweeping East 100..160
wps = [(100,-25),(160,-25),(160,0),(100,0),(100,25),(160,25)]
items = []
for e,n in wps:
    g = await world_to_geo(e, n, 20)
    items.append(mission_item(latitude_deg=g.latitude_deg, longitude_deg=g.longitude_deg, relative_altitude_m=20))
await drone.mission.set_return_to_launch_after_mission(True)
await drone.mission.upload_mission(MissionPlan(items))
await arm_and_start()
async for mp in drone.mission.mission_progress():
    log(f"d0 {mp.current}/{mp.total}")
    if mp.total>0 and mp.current==mp.total:
        break
log("d0 survey done, RTL engaged")
